annotations.summary: The synthetic-monitor has not reported service_health for 3+ minutes — infrastructure availability is UNKNOWN (the probe pod is down, can't reach InfluxDB, or the write token is broken). Check: kubectl get pods -n ai -l app=synthetic-monitor.

model.query:
from(bucket: "kube_metrics")
  |> range(start: -3m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_health" and r._field == "up")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _time: now() }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
